title: The Hungarian Schools of Fencing and Water Polo
grammar: Dynamic motion preverbs of overcoming and defense (kicselez, lefut, kivéd)
goal: I can explain the strategic concepts and legendary coaching methods behind Hungarian fencing and water polo dynasties.
I can employ dynamic motion preverbs (kicselez, kivéd, leúszik, túljár az eszén) to describe tactical duels and athletic confrontations.
I can discuss multi-time Olympic champions (Gerevich Aladár, Kárpáti György) and team psychology.
